description: This Java class serves as a REST controller in a banking application, specifically managing account and transaction operations. It provides endpoints for retrieving account info, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction history.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST API controller for handling account and transaction requests in the banking application.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account information by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new bank account for a specific customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to transfer funds between accounts for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch transaction history for a given account number.
